name: GEEKED by MKX - 3G Disposables LIMITED EDITION - Strawberry Sangria - Hybrid
description: Enjoy the easygoing atmosphere of a summer brunch with Strawberry Sangria. Featuring a sweet, citrus-forward profile of strawberry, orange, and lemon, this hybrid strain is your go-to for sunny, social gatherings. Designed for relaxation, it’s the ultimate choice for a casual, happy day.
